cluster_summary: Multiple endpoints and data publications fail to verify that users have appropriate access to the requested resources. This includes missing validation of parent-child resource relationships, using incorrect permission levels, lacking authentication on sensitive data endpoints, failing to project out sensitive fields, trusting client-supplied identifiers for ownership, stale authorization caches, user-supplied projection bypass, and unvalidated webhook URLs leading to SSRF.
guideline_text: Trace externally reachable requests, RPC messages, management calls, or background command triggers into privileged commands, administrative state changes, credential operations, or protected data access. Report code paths where caller identity is not established before the privileged action begins. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 6 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should require a validated session, principal, token, or authentication filter before any privileged effect.

mechanism.missing_guard: caller identity is not established before the privileged action begins
mechanism.name: missing authentication before privileged action
mechanism.sink_shape: privileged commands, administrative state changes, credential operations, or protected data access
mechanism.source_shape: externally reachable requests, RPC messages, management calls, or background command triggers
mechanism.typical_fix: require a validated session, principal, token, or authentication filter before any privileged effect

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Add authentication checks (e.g., require valid session) and authorization filters based on user's accessible resources before returning data.
sub_patterns.name: Missing authentication/authorization on data retrieval endpoints
sub_patterns.root_cause: Endpoints that return sensitive data do not verify the caller's authentication or authorization to access the data, assuming only authorized clients will invoke them.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Add an explicit projection to exclude sensitive fields or only include non-sensitive fields in database queries.
sub_patterns.name: Missing field projection exposing sensitive data
sub_patterns.root_cause: Database queries are performed without specifying a field projection, causing all fields including sensitive tokens or user credentials to be returned.
